description: Merge multiple playlists into one. Deduplicates tracks across sources (first-seen order wins) and adds them in batches of 100. Pass target_playlist_id to append to an existing playlist (it is NOT cleared) or new_name to create a fresh playlist.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

new_name.description: Name for a newly created target playlist

items.description: Playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or Spotify playlist URL; use this reference in the canonical or documented legacy field

public.description: Visibility of a NEW playlist. Default: false

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

scan_cap.description: Maximum source rows to scan; bounded by SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP

target_playlist_id.description: Existing playlist to APPEND into (never cleared)

name: merge_playlists
